```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(levante)
```

```{r}
# processed datasets to fetch, pinned to the versions the committed data/ was
# fetched from (verified; see README)
data_sources <- list("pilot_uniandes_co_rural:bxgv",
                     "pilot_uniandes_co_bogota:d0c5",
                     "pilot_mpieva_de_main:8wjx",
                     "pilot_western_ca_main:bgcj")
data_versions <- list("v4.0", "v3.0", "v2.0", "v2.0")

# fetch processed trials data
trials <- map2(data_sources, data_versions, get_trials)

# subset to mental rotation
trials_mrot <- trials |>
  list_rbind() |>
  filter(item_task == "mrot")

# nest by site and dataset
task_data_nested <- trials_mrot |>
  nest(data = -c(item_task, site, dataset))

write_rds(task_data_nested, "data/task_data_nested.rds", compress = "gz")

runs <- map2(data_sources, data_versions, get_scores)

runs_mrot <- runs |>
  list_rbind() |>
  filter(task_code == "mrot") |>
  select(site, dataset, run_id, user_id, age, language, adaptive, num_attempted,
         max_incorrect, max_time)

write_rds(runs_mrot, "data/runs_mrot.rds", compress = "gz")
```
